rollups.text: Fitness goals and exercise plans: By 2023-04, the user was doing charity runs and walks and wanted to improve their 5K personal best by a few minutes. On 2023-04-20, they completed the Breast Cancer Awareness Walk and raised $500. Around 2023-05-09, a hike with friends made them feel out of shape; by 2023-05-23, they were trying to establish a regular exercise routine and considering a budget-friendly gym with cardio, weights, and group classes. On 2023-05-23, they said gym classes designed for people in their 30s had helped them stay motivated. They also considered spin class to build cardio endurance and prepare for a June 2023 charity bike ride, but enrollment and participation were not confirmed.

Soccer participation and next steps: The user played forward in a co-ed soccer league that ran August 15–October 3 (year unspecified), scoring 7 goals; a later account also says they made 3 assists. On 2023-05-25, they were looking for another recreational team and considering defense or goalkeeper, planned to learn through online resources, and wanted to improve speed and agility. They also considered a fitness-focused recreational league as preparation for more competitive play and planned to mention their prior experience modestly when signing up. No new team or position was confirmed.

Report deadline and work plan: After taking a half-day off on 2023-05-22 for a morning doctor’s appointment, the user fell behind on an unnamed project report due around 2023-06-08. On 2023-05-25, the user agreed to a proposed schedule: review data and outline in the first week, write Monday through Wednesday of the following week, then review and finalize Thursday and Friday. They said they would follow the plan; no report completion was recorded. The deadline was about two weeks after the planning discussion.

Five-acre Oakdale weekend getaway: On 2023-05-28, the user said they had recently inherited a 5-acre property in Oakdale from their grandmother and planned to make it a weekend getaway. They had already met one contractor and wanted to explore other options; they were considering landscaping and a small garden, and exploring solar panels for self-sufficiency. The user asked about selling their city condo to help fund the project, but no decision to sell was stated. No construction, landscaping, or solar installation was confirmed.

Los Angeles travel and meetup plans: By 2023-05-24, the user planned a June 2023 Los Angeles trip to meet freelance journalist Sophia, whom they had met on a Chicago-to-New York flight a few weeks earlier. They planned coffee at Verve Coffee Roasters in West Hollywood, possibly a walk, and might suggest lunch at The Apple Pan; they planned to ask about outdoor seating if weather permitted. By 2023-05-27, the user was also planning a five-day Los Angeles trip with casual dinner with friends, light sightseeing, remote work, the Getty Center, and Venice Beach Boardwalk. They expected mild, sunny weather with a slight chance of rain, needed a laptop and camera, prioritized comfortable sneakers and their usual skincare, tended to overpack, and intended to try packing cubes. The trip and meetup were plans, not confirmed as completed.

Handmade products and market selling: The user sells handmade candles and soaps and had recently returned to local markets; at a Saturday farmers’ market a few weeks before 2023-05-24, they made about $250. On 2023-05-24, they considered applying to an annual convention-center craft fair, liked offering demonstrations and samples, and planned to propose sharing a booth and cross-promoting with a local jewelry maker. For the fair, they planned a 10%-off offer on purchases of $50 or more and a free travel-sized candle with a soap-and-lotion set; they also considered a loyalty program, but no structure was chosen. Separately, the user sells homemade jam at a weekly farmers’ market and reported a steady increase in customers; they were developing seasonal flavors and packaging and considering multi-jar discounts and a holiday-market display. These plans and proposed promotions were not confirmed as implemented.

Market-selling milestones and ideas: In April 2023, the user attended a local small-business-association seminar on market-stall design. A few weeks before 2023-05-24, the user made about $250 at a Saturday farmers’ market selling handmade candles and soaps. By 2023-05-30, the user said homemade jam sales at a weekly farmers’ market were increasing. Products and plans mentioned include handmade candles and soaps; jam flavors such as spicy pepper jelly and cranberry-orange marmalade; a possible 10% discount for buying three or more different jam flavors; seasonal gift labels and packaging; a rustic winter-wonderland holiday stall; and possible gifts with purchase. The user also considered applying to a craft fair, demonstrations and samples, and partnering with a jewelry maker. Proposed promotions were not all confirmed as implemented.

Max’s care, supplies, and toys: By 2023-05-22, the user tracked monthly supplies for Max, a dog with sensitive skin: about $50 for grain-free kibble and $10 for one pack of dental chews, for about $60 recurring monthly. The user had started a new kind of dental chew and wondered whether it helped. One-time purchases included a dog bed for about $40 and a flea-and-tick collar for $20. On 2023-05-26, the user described Max as a 3-year-old golden retriever who enjoys fetch and squeaky toys; they had bought a $15 stainless-steel food bowl and a $5 measuring cup. Max loved his black-and-brown cushioned PetSmart bed. The user decided to get a Kong Classic treat-dispensing toy but had not said it was purchased.

Savory snacks and homemade snack experiments: On 2023-05-25, the user said they had been on a savory-snack kick for about two weeks. They love spicy roasted chickpeas and had made a successful batch the week before; they had stocked up on Kettle Brand Spicy Thai chips and eaten them with hummus for lunch on three days that week. They were considering savory snack subscription boxes but did not say they subscribed. They had also made homemade buffalo-ranch popcorn successfully and planned to try Spicy Korean BBQ popcorn over 2023-05-27–2023-05-28; they liked spicy food and found gochujang with soy sauce appealing. They were also considering homemade granola bars.

Mindfulness and well-being: On 2023-05-23, the user said growing responsibilities were affecting their overall well-being and they wanted to prioritize mental health and stress management. They said gym classes had helped with motivation and expressed interest in beginner mindfulness meditation. The assistant suggested stress-management practices and beginner meditation resources; the user’s specific meditation practice or ongoing use of an app was not confirmed.

Comedy writing and open-mic plans: On 2023-05-28, the user said they had recently met comedian Rachel at an open mic and laughed hard at her dating-app joke, which compared choosing on a dating app to ordering food delivery and receiving a mess. The user was writing jokes about online learning platforms, wanted to improve joke structure, and was considering trying new material at an upcoming open mic. They planned to consult suggested joke-writing resources, but no performance was confirmed.
The user said a Twitter thread received 12 comments around 2023-05-21; they described that as a lot for them. The thread’s topic was not specified.

The user’s reported soccer statistics from a co-ed league running August 15–October 3 (year unspecified) were 7 goals and, in a later account, 3 assists. The user played forward; no later league statistics were recorded.

For the 2022 workforce, the user gave beginning headcount of 741, ending headcount of 809, and 169 departures. Using average headcount of 775, the estimated annual turnover rate was 169 ÷ 775 × 100 = approximately 21.81% (about 22%). On 2023-05-25, the user also asked about a separate calculation using 177 departures and an average workforce of 700, which gives approximately 25.29%.

The user reported several purchase and sales amounts: about $250 in sales at a Saturday farmers’ market a few weeks before 2023-05-24; approximately $60 per month for Max’s grain-free kibble and dental chews as of 2023-05-22; one-time Max purchases of a roughly $40 bed and $20 flea-and-tick collar; and, on 2023-05-26, a $15 stainless-steel bowl and $5 measuring cup.
